name: Buck 12V->5V
description: Automotive step-down converter (e.g. LM2596/MP1584). Turns the vehicle 12 V into a clean 5 V rail for the ESP32-S3 (fed into the board's USB-C / 5 V input).
notes: Prefer a separate switched 12 V feed (ignition +) over the diagnostic-port 12 V, which is only weakly fused. Set the output to a solid 5.0 V before connecting the board.
